name: Majika Madoka
source:
A cheerful and energetic classmate of protagonist.

Her popularity among boys is second only to Yuna. She and Yuna are very good friends and always together.

She doesn't like studying. Even though she isn't in any club, her athletic ability is superb. 

"Recently, my privates feel itchy during class. Makes me want to pee."
